words.intro: Teach a **turtle** to draw. Start with a square, then change one number and watch it twist into a galaxy.
words.finished: Every line of that spiral came from your loop.
words.tinker: Keep tinkering: try angles like 59, 89, 121 or 144, and press Save picture under the stage to keep your favourite.

milestones.title: Draw a shape
milestones.goal: A square and a triangle, drawn by your turtle.

steps.instruction: Meet the turtle! It starts in the middle, facing right. What will this code draw? Pick your guess, then press **Run**.
choices: An L shape: a line across, then a line down
steps.explain: The turtle walks 100 steps, turns **right** by 90 degrees (a quarter turn), then walks 100 more. Two lines with a corner: an L!

check.description: Your turtle drew its first lines!

hints: Read the code one line at a time, like instructions for a robot.
`forward(100)` walks and draws. `right(90)` turns a quarter turn without moving.
`t.forward(50)` then `t.left(90)` then `t.forward(50)` would draw a corner going up.
It walks across, turns right (so now it faces ______), and walks again.
It draws an L: a line across, then a line down. Pick that answer and press Run.

steps.instruction: Finish the square! A square has **4 sides** and **4 corners**. Add more `t.right(90)` and `t.forward(100)` lines until the turtle gets back to where it started.
hints: You have 2 sides. Add lines at the bottom of your code.
Each side is `t.forward(100)` and each corner is `t.right(90)`.
After the second side: `t.right(90)` then `t.forward(100)` draws side 3.
Add: `t.right(90)`, `t.forward(100)`, `t.right(___)`, `t.forward(___)`.
Add these 4 lines: `t.right(90)`, `t.forward(100)`, `t.right(90)`, `t.forward(100)`.

steps.instruction: Now a **loop** draws the sides for you. This one draws 3 sides. Fill the blank with the turn that makes a triangle.
hints: The blank is the angle in `t.right(___)`.
To get back to the start, all the turns must add up to one full spin: 360 degrees.
A square has 4 turns of 90, because 4 × 90 = 360.
A triangle has 3 turns, so each turn is 360 ÷ 3 = ___.
`t.right(120)`. Run it, then try `range(5)` with `t.right(72)` for a pentagon!

milestones.title: Grow a spiral
milestones.goal: A spiral that grows and twists.

steps.instruction: Look at `size = size + 5` inside the loop. What do you think the turtle will draw?
choices: A square spiral that grows outwards
40 squares on top of each other
steps.explain: Each time round the loop, `size` grows by 5, so every line is a bit longer than the last. Turn 90° each time and you get a square spiral.
hints: Watch what happens to `size` each time round the loop.
`size = size + 5` takes what's in the box and adds 5.
First line: 5 steps. Next: 10. Then 15…
The lines get ______ and the turtle turns 90° each time.
A square spiral that grows outwards. Pick that answer and press Run.

steps.instruction: Here's the magic trick: change the angle in `t.right(90)` to **91**. Then try others, like 89, 121 or 144!

check.description: One degree turned a square into a galaxy!

hints: There's only one angle in the code: inside `t.right(...)`.
When the angle isn't exactly 90, each square comes out a little bit twisted.
`t.right(60)` makes a hexagon spiral.
`t.right(__)`: try a number close to 90, but not 90.
Change it to `t.right(91)` and Run. Then try 121!

milestones.title: Add colour
milestones.goal: A rainbow spiral that's different every run.

steps.instruction: Now there's a **list** of colours. `random.choice(...)` picks one from a list. Fill the blank with the name of the list.
hints: The blank is inside `random.choice(___)`.
`random.choice` needs a list to pick from. The list is stored in a variable.
`random.choice(snacks)` would pick from a list called snacks.
`random.choice(c______)`
`t.color(random.choice(colours))`. Run it twice: is it the same both times?

steps.instruction: Make it your design: change the colours in the list, the angle, or how many lines (`range(80)`). Find one you love, then press **Save picture** under the stage.

check.description: That's an original. Save it as a poster!

hints: You can change the list, the angle, the size step or the range.
Colours need quotes and commas between them, like `["gold", "cyan"]`.
`colours = ["gold", "cyan", "magenta"]` gives a neon spiral.
Try `t.right(___)` with 59, 121 or 144.
Change the list to `["gold", "cyan", "magenta"]` and the angle to `t.right(121)`, then Run.

milestones.title: Think like an artist
milestones.goal: Know which number made the magic.

steps.instruction: Quick question before you go. Which change turned the square into a twisting galaxy?
steps.explain: Just one degree! When the turn isn't a clean 90, every square comes out slightly rotated, and together they twist into a galaxy.
hints: Think back to the step where the square spiral became a galaxy.
Colours change how it looks, but not its shape.
The shape comes from how far the turtle walks and how much it turns.
It was a number inside `t.right(...)`.
Changing the angle from 90 to 91.
